note: The repeated layer's reach after K = 1..10 iterations: the largest lookahead L such that the read-out after K answers every lookahead from 1 to L on at least 99% of the benchmark's test questions (1,000 per lookahead at 49 towns, 500 at 125), scored by the training run itself on this checkpoint. The most a pair can know after K iterations is a route of 2^K roads.
